claims.claim_text: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration to advance Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
claims.excerpt: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ to bring together NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform

claims.claim_text: Rebellions plans to use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units to the NVIDIA platform.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units (NPUs) to the NVIDIA platform, and harness the NVIDIA MGX™ rack architecture

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to deploy these Rebellions-based systems in its AI data center to support its full-stack sovereign AI strategy.
claims.excerpt: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems, drawing on its AI data center operations expertise, proprietary models and services.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions' R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions’ R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.

claims.claim_text: The companies plan to pursue disaggregated inference, using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.
claims.excerpt: Their planned work includes using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.

claims.claim_text: The collaboration is supported by Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT).
claims.excerpt: Supported by Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), the collaboration aims to support AI services tailored to Korea’s language, industries and priorities

claims.claim_text: Rebellions is developing its next-generation R200 NPU, which it says is optimized for low-latency and energy-efficient inference using frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions is developing its next-generation R200 NPU, optimized for low-latency and energy-efficient inference using frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to connect its infrastructure with its proprietary models, including A.X K2, and public-facing services under Korea's AI for All project.
claims.excerpt: By linking SKT’s AI data centers, proprietary AI models including A.X K2, and public-facing AI services developed under the ‘AI for All’ project
